wiki.title: George Lang (Ohio politician)
wiki.extract: George F. Lang (born March 22, 1962) is an American politician. A Republican, he became the state senator for Ohio's 4th senatorial district in 2021. He was previously the representative for the 52nd District of the Ohio House of Representatives. The district consists of West Chester Township, Liberty Township, Fairfield Township and part of the City of Sharonville, Ohio in Butler County.
